hunt.justification: Ransomware recovery depends on VSS integrity; identifying its disruption confirms a critical disruption of disaster recovery processes.

meta.name: Ransomware Recovery Inhibition and Encryption

related.reason: Data exfiltration typically precedes encryption and requires network/cloud telemetry analysis.

scenario.summary: Ransomware operators frequently target the Windows Volume Shadow Copy Service (VSS) to delete local snapshots before or during the encryption process. By inhibiting system recovery, adversaries ensure that victims cannot use 'Previous Versions' or other local restore points to recover data, thereby increasing the likelihood of ransom payment.

meta.rationale: Focus on file servers and database servers where VSS snapshots are critical for recovery. Start with any host showing vssadmin or wmic deletion activity.
meta.hypothesis: An adversary is inhibiting system recovery by deleting volume shadow copies using standard tools or scripts before performing mass file encryption with rare extensions.

blind_spots.risk: Adversaries using custom binaries to call VSS APIs directly will not be caught by command-line based queries.
blind_spots.question: Was the shadow copy deletion performed using direct API calls rather than command-line tools?
blind_spots.requires: Direct VSS API monitoring via EDR

blind_spots.risk: Mass encryption generates thousands of events; sensor-level truncation can mask the scale of the impact.
blind_spots.question: Did the endpoint sensor truncate high-volume rename events during the encryption phase?

hunt.name: Ransomware Recovery Inhibition and Encryption
hunt.description: This hunt identifies the destructive impact phase of a ransomware intrusion by looking for recovery inhibition and data encryption. It lead-scopes the estate for the use of VSS-manipulation tools, then fans out to corroborate this with scripted shadow copy deletion, the creation of known ransom-note filenames, and fleet-wide anomalous file rename activity. An agent evaluates the combined evidence to distinguish between legitimate administrative maintenance and a live ransomware event.

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, process_name, process_cmd_line, user_name, time FROM hb_process_activity WHERE (instr(',' || '{{vss_tools}}' || ',', ',' || LOWER(process_original_file_name) || ',') > 0 OR instr(',' || '{{vss_tools}}' || ',', ',' || LOWER(process_name) || ',') > 0) AND (instr(LOWER(process_cmd_line), 'delete') > 0 AND instr(LOWER(process_cmd_line), 'shadow') > 0) AND ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')
config.description: Identify execution of tools known to delete shadow copies by matching binary names and looking for deletion keywords in the command line.
config.expected_signal: Rows showing specific hosts and processes attempting shadow copy deletion. Silence suggests no obvious recovery inhibition via command line tools.

primitive_config.label: Lead: VSS Snapshot Deletion Command

primitive_config.expected: Rows showing specific hosts and processes attempting shadow copy deletion. Silence suggests no obvious recovery inhibition via command line tools.

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, script_name, script_content, actor_user_name, time FROM hb_script_activity WHERE (instr(LOWER(script_content), 'win32_shadowcopy') > 0 AND instr(LOWER(script_content), '.delete()') > 0) AND ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')
config.description: Find programmatic shadow copy deletion in script blocks that might bypass process monitoring.
config.expected_signal: Script blocks calling the WMI Delete method on shadow objects. Silence proof of absence depends on script block logging coverage.

primitive_config.label: Scripted WMI Shadow Copy Deletion

primitive_config.expected: Script blocks calling the WMI Delete method on shadow objects. Silence proof of absence depends on script block logging coverage.

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, file_name, file_path, process_name, time FROM hb_file_activity WHERE instr(',' || '{{ransom_notes}}' || ',', ',' || LOWER(file_name) || ',') > 0 AND ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')
config.description: Find creation of files matching a known list of ransom-note names.
config.expected_signal: Creation of files like readme.txt or decrypt.txt in multiple directories.

primitive_config.label: Ransom Note Creation
primitive_config.content: SELECT device_hostname, file_name, file_path, process_name, time FROM hb_file_activity WHERE instr(',' || '{{ransom_notes}}' || ',', ',' || LOWER(file_name) || ',') > 0 AND ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')
primitive_config.expected: Creation of files like readme.txt or decrypt.txt in multiple directories.

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, process_name, actor_user_name AS user_name, LOWER(SUBSTR(file_name, INSTR(file_name, '.') + 1)) AS extension, COUNT(*) AS event_count, MIN(time) AS first_seen FROM hb_file_activity WHERE activity_id = 5 AND file_name LIKE '%.%' AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') AND ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) GROUP BY device_hostname, process_name, user_name, extension HAVING event_count > 500
config.description: Stack-count file renames to identify anomalous volume of extensions that are rare across the fleet.
config.expected_signal: A high volume of renames to a single extension that is not common across the fleet.

primitive_config.label: Mass Renames to Rare Extensions
primitive_config.content: SELECT device_hostname, process_name, actor_user_name AS user_name, LOWER(SUBSTR(file_name, INSTR(file_name, '.') + 1)) AS extension, COUNT(*) AS event_count, MIN(time) AS first_seen FROM hb_file_activity WHERE activity_id = 5 AND file_name LIKE '%.%' AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') AND ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) GROUP BY device_hostname, process_name, user_name, extension HAVING event_count > 500
primitive_config.expected: A high volume of renames to a single extension that is not common across the fleet.
